heading.en: Birth, marriage and early military career

body.zh-Hant: 君士坦丁一世於1868年（舊曆7月21日，新曆8月2日）生於雅典，是喬治一世國王與俄國女大公奧爾加的長子。1889年10月（舊曆14日，新曆27日）他娶索菲亞公主，她是德意志皇帝威廉的妹妹。1896至1897年的希土戰爭中他是作戰部隊的總帥，這場戰爭對他個人是一次失敗。1909年他被免職，8月15日（新曆28日）前往巴黎；韋尼澤洛斯讓人把他召回，1910年他被任命為陸軍總監，三年內整訓出一支十五萬人的軍隊。
body.en: Constantine was born in Athens on 21 July (2 August) 1868, the eldest son of King George of Greece and Grand Duchess Olga of Russia. On 14/27 October 1889 he married Princess Sophia, the sister of the German emperor William. In the Greco-Turkish war of 1896-1897 he was generalissimo of the troops in the field, and the war was a personal failure for him. Dismissed in 1909, he left for Paris on 15/28 August; Venizelos had him recalled, and in 1910 he was appointed inspector general of the army, which he built up in three years into a force of 150,000 men.

body.zh-Hant: 希臘加入巴爾幹同盟出自韋尼澤洛斯之手，而軍事上的成功則歸功於君士坦丁。他在薩蘭達波隆與韋里亞擊敗土耳其軍，1912年11月9日進入薩洛尼卡，比保加利亞人早一天，並決定了約阿尼納的投降。喬治國王遇刺後，他於1913年3月18日（舊曆3月5日）繼承王位。
body.en: Greece's entry into the Balkan League was Venizelos's work, but the military successes were Constantine's credit. He defeated the Turks at Sarantaporo and Verria, entered Salonika on 9 November 1912, one day before the Bulgarians, and decided the capitulation of Ioannina. After King George was assassinated, he succeeded to the throne on 18 March 1913 (5 March old style).

heading.zh-Hant: 中立政策與第一次退位

body.zh-Hant: 1915年1月，韋尼澤洛斯曾勸他對同盟國宣戰；3月5日的王室會議上，君士坦丁要求二十四小時考慮，隨後決定「還不是時候」，韋尼澤洛斯辭職。他深信德國會獲勝，主張中立，表面上善意對協約國、實質上偏向德國。1915年9月保加利亞進攻塞爾維亞，韋尼澤洛斯再度被免職，希臘分裂成兩個對立陣營。1916年12月10日，他下令向駐雅典的協約國部隊開火。1917年6月10日薩拉伊將軍的部隊在比雷埃夫斯登陸，他於6月11日退位，把王位交給次子亞歷山大，並前往瑞士。
body.en: In January 1915 Venizelos tried to induce him to declare war on the Central Powers; at the Crown Council of 5 March he asked for 24 hours to decide and then said "not yet", whereupon Venizelos resigned. Persuaded that the Germans would win, he chose neutrality, benevolent toward the Entente in appearance but toward the Germans in substance. After the Bulgarian attack on Serbia in September 1915 Venizelos was dismissed again and Greece was divided into two opposed camps. On 10 December 1916 he had troops fire on the Entente forces quartered in Athens. On 10 June 1917 General Sarrail's troops landed at Piraeus; he abdicated on 11 June in favour of his second son Alexander and went to Switzerland.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年10月25日年輕的亞歷山大國王去世後，君士坦丁以文告宣稱對王位的主張。1920年11月14日的選舉近乎公民投票，他被召回，並於12月19日重掌權力；當時希臘已在安那托利亞作戰半年，他繼續軍事行動。戰爭以慘敗收場，各島嶼起而反抗並要求他退位；他於1922年9月27日放棄王位，傳位給兒子喬治。他於1923年1月11日在巴勒莫去世。
body.en: After the young King Alexander died on 25 October 1920, Constantine claimed the throne by proclamation. The election of 14 November 1920, a veritable plebiscite, recalled him, and he resumed power on 19 December 1920, when Greece had already been at war in Anatolia for six months, and he continued the military operations. After the disastrous outcome of that war the islands rebelled and demanded his abdication; he renounced the throne on 27 September 1922 in favour of his son George. He died in Palermo on 11 January 1923.

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾貝茨·克維西斯1881年12月22日生於塔爾韋特教區的卡爾納穆伊扎，早年由父母在家教育，之後就讀於耶爾加瓦中學。1902年他進入塔爾圖大學法學院，1907年畢業，隨後在耶爾加瓦執業為律師。他積極參與社會生活，曾任耶爾加瓦拉脫維亞協會代理會長，並是當地紅十字會拉脫維亞委員會的成員。
body.en: Alberts Kviesis was born on 22 December 1881 at Kalnamuiža in the Tērvete rural district and was first educated at home by his parents, then studied at Jelgava Grammar School. In 1902 he entered the Faculty of Law at the University of Tartu and graduated in 1907, after which he practised as an attorney in Jelgava. He took an active part in public life, serving as acting chief of the Jelgava Latvian Society and as a member of the Red Cross Latvian Committee in Jelgava.

heading.en: The independence movement and judicial posts

body.zh-Hant: 1917年4月25日，他出席在塔爾圖召開的庫爾蘇梅地方代表大會，被選入庫爾蘇梅臨時地方議會；5月28日拉脫維亞律師代表大會又選他進入塔爾圖的拉脫維亞律師局。依德國國家圖書館權威檔，他1917年加入新成立的拉脫維亞農民聯盟，1918年成為拉脫維亞人民議會成員。1918年11月17日他是人民議會代表之一，並被選為議會司法副主席。1919年7月23日他被選為司法小組成員，1923年3月26日當選為首席法官（Chief Justice）。
body.en: On 25 April 1917 he attended the Kurzeme local assembly in Tartu, where he was elected to the Provisional Land Council of Kurzeme; on 28 May the Congress of Latvian Lawyers elected him to the Bureau of Latvian Lawyers in Tartu. According to the German national authority file, he joined the newly founded Latvian Farmers' Union in 1917 and became a member of the Latvian People's Council in 1918. On 17 November 1918 he was among the People's Council delegates and was elected Vice-Chairman of Justice of the Council. On 23 July 1919 he was elected a member of the Judicial Panel and on 26 March 1923 Chief Justice.

body.zh-Hant: 1927年克維西斯參選總統，但當選者是古斯塔夫斯·澤姆加爾斯。1930年他成為拉脫維亞總統，1933年連任。1934年5月15日總理卡爾利斯·烏爾馬尼斯發動政變，克維西斯仍留任至任期結束（1936年）；政變後總統失去實權。依官方頁面所述，他任總統期間既未自行提出法案送交議會，也未退回任何法案要求覆議，也未在里加城堡召開內閣會議。
body.en: In 1927 Kviesis ran for the presidency, but Gustavs Zemgals was elected. In 1930 he became President of Latvia and was re-elected in 1933. After the coup organized by Prime Minister Kārlis Ulmanis on 15 May 1934, Kviesis retained his post until the end of his mandate (until 1936); after the coup the President lost real power. According to the official page, throughout his presidency he neither submitted any bill of his own to the Saeima, nor sent back any bill for reconsideration, nor convened any meeting of the Cabinet of Ministers in Riga Castle.

heading.en: After the presidency and last years

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後，克維西斯恢復律師業務。1941年6月14日，他事先得知將被流放，躲到塔爾韋特教區偏遠的護林人小屋，當年秋天繼續執業。1943年3月，德國駐拉脫維亞總專員（來源作Drekslers）任命他進入納粹設立的合作性拉脫維亞自治機構，擔任司法總監；一年後他因心臟病辭職。1944年8月9日，他在「蒙特羅莎」號船上去世，該船剛駛離里加港前往德國，他被葬於里加的梅扎墓園。
body.en: Having resigned as President, Kviesis resumed his practice of law. On 14 June 1941, knowing in advance of the expected deportation, he hid in a remote forest-guard house in Tērvete and in the fall of 1941 continued his practice of law. In March 1943 Drekslers, the German general commissar in Latvia, appointed him Director General of Justice in the collaborationist Latvian self-government established by the Nazis; he resigned a year later because of heart disease. He died on board the ship Monte Rosa on 9 August 1944, just after it left the port of Riga for Germany, and was buried at Meža Cemetery in Riga.

heading.en: Birth and entry into the Agrarian League

body.zh-Hant: 勞里·克里斯蒂安·雷蘭德1883年5月31日生於芬蘭的克羅諾堡。1907年他加入芬蘭農業黨（農民聯盟）。
body.en: Lauri Kristian Relander was born on 31 May 1883 at Kronoborg in Finland. In 1907 he joined the Finnish Agrarian Party (the Agrarian League).

citations.quote: 31. mai 1883, Kronoborg, Finland
1907 Eintritt in die finnische Agrarpartei

heading.zh-Hant: 研究助理、議員與農民聯盟黨魁
heading.en: Research assistant, deputy and Agrarian League chairman

body.zh-Hant: 1908至1917年他在國營農業經濟研究中心任助理。依丹麥《Lex》，他在1910至1913年及1917至1920年代表農民聯盟出任國會議員。1917年他成為農民聯盟主席，挪威《Store norske leksikon》指出，他1917至1919年的最後一段議員任期同時擔任黨的主席。德國國家圖書館權威檔另載他在1919年任議長。
body.en: From 1908 to 1917 he worked as an assistant at the economic research centre for state agriculture. According to the Danish Lex, he sat in the Diet for the Agrarian League in 1910-1913 and 1917-1920. In 1917 he became chairman of the Agrarian League; Store norske leksikon notes that his last term as a member, 1917 to 1919, was as party chairman. The German authority file also records that he was Speaker of Parliament in 1919.

body.zh-Hant: 1920至1925年他擔任維堡省（維伊普里省）省長。1925至1931年任芬蘭總統；他由農民聯盟、國民聯合黨與瑞典人民黨的票數當選，起初設法彌合紅白之間以及語言群體之間的分歧，1926年任命內戰後第一個社會民主黨政府。1929年起他對右翼的拉普阿運動表現出同情，1931年因農民聯盟未再提名他為總統候選人而退出政壇。
body.en: From 1920 to 1925 he was governor of Viipuri (Viborg) province. He was President of Finland from 1925 to 1931; elected with the votes of the Agrarian League, the National Coalition Party and the Swedish People's Party, he first sought to bridge the divisions between reds and whites and between the language groups, and in 1926 appointed the first Social Democratic government since the civil war. From 1929 he showed some sympathy for the right-wing Lapua movement, and in 1931 he withdrew from politics after his party did not renominate him as presidential candidate.

body.zh-Hant: 雷蘭德退出政壇後，於1942年2月9日在赫爾辛基去世。
body.en: After withdrawing from politics, Relander died in Helsinki on 9 February 1942.
